evidence.command: env -u PYTEST_ADDOPTS PYTHONPATH=<tree> python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_no_clock.py tests/core/test_import_graph.py

findings.statement: No test asserts the store's own import boundary, so the amended rule (store imports core and snapshot and nothing else) is prose only.
findings.failure_scenario: A later edit adding 'import cvi.collect.github_rest' or 'from cvi.serve import api' to cvi/store/writer.py passes the whole suite; the existing test only constrains cvi/core and cvi/derive/bundle.py.

observations: The packet owns cvi/store/* and its tests, so extending the import-graph test is in scope and is about six lines.
R-B holds as written: the only non-core imports are cvi.snapshot.populations and cvi.snapshot.reproduce.
